name: 30524-sharegpt-qwen3-8bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no sequence parallelism, one vLLM engine.
architecture: 8.2B-parameter dense decoder (Qwen3ForCausalLM), 36 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads with head_dim 128 (GQA), FP8 e4m3 weights block-quantised at 128x128, ~8.5 GB of checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=100, warmup 5%, no cooldown, bounded at 2000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed static 30524. Warmup comes out of the bound rather than being extra.
workload: a 2000-row ShareGPT V3 draw materialised into `configs/data/sharegpt-2000-qwen3-8b-fp8.jsonl` by `configs/data/make-dataset.py` (deterministic at its default seed 0, tokenised with this checkpoint's own tokenizer). 446619 prompt tokens and 412714 output tokens, long-tailed: prompts mean 223 (min 4, p50 101, p90 626, max 1007), replies mean 206 (min 4, p50 145, p90 502, max 1839). Each row carries its reply's own length as `output_tokens_count`, so the backend sets `ignore_eos` and generation runs to exactly that many tokens. Raw completions (`request_format: plain`, `/v1/completions`), temperature 0.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on an 8-billion-parameter model, serving 100 concurrent users with varied conversational turns on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: commit 2cc5affc388d3d134bacc14f042405ead925531b (v0.13.0rc1-65-g2cc5affc38).
# max-num-batched-tokens is written out because the default differs between launch paths.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
